name: Tween
src_typeComment: Plug-and-play tween engine: Tween.Float/Vector3/Color start a tween immediately with zero setup (no GameObject to add, no component to configure) and return a TweenHandle you can Kill()/Pause() later. See TweenExtensions for DOTween-style shortcuts (transform.TweenScale(...) etc.) built on top of these.
